the jacquemus secret: scale disruption in public streets.

No Photoshop needed. Just this 3-minute formula with copy-paste prompts 🧵👇

1/ Why 90% of AI visuals look messy:

• Starting with a blank prompt
• Too many elements (clutter)
• Zero grid structure

Rule: Lock your layout with a reference image first.

2/ Step 1: Pick a Grid Blueprint

Never start from scratch. Upload an aesthetic poster with bold stacked typography and let Nano Banana copy the layout & font spacing.

3/ Step 2: The Exact Prompt Formula

"Use reference image for layout. Swap title to: [YOUR TITLE]. 50mm clean prime, raking key light, 35mm grain, 4:5 vertical."

4/ Step 3: Layer Micro-Accents

• Pastel pink/lime highlighter behind keywords
• Speech bubbles for mini notes
• Floating 3D emojis (🍒, ⚡, 🪩, 🖱️) around letters

5/ 💾 The Saveable Cheat Sheet:

• Ratio: 1080x1350 (4:5)
• Background: Off-white graph paper (#F8F8F5)
• Typography: Bold Sans + Editorial Serif
• Finish: 50mm prime, 35mm film grain

6/ The 3-Minute Routine:

1. Save 5 Pinterest references
2. Feed into Nano Banana with 3-line copy formula
3. Export & deliver via automated DM keyword

7/ Golden Rules:

✦ Stop the scroll on Slide 1
✦ Explain with diagrams on Slides 2-7
✦ Give away free prompts on every post
